name: How much do bathroom accessibility modifications cost in Denver?

mainEntity.name: How much do bathroom accessibility modifications cost in Denver?

acceptedAnswer.text: Costs vary widely based on the scope, but Denver-area accessibility conversions commonly range from a few thousand dollars for targeted changes to much more for a full remodel. The biggest cost drivers are shower replacement, layout changes, waterproofing, wall reinforcement, and fixture upgrades.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cost depends on the scope, from targeted safety upgrades to full remodels. Shower changes, layout work, and structural updates usually drive the price up most.
